Tatiana once spearheaded a project to revamp our customer data pipeline, which was plagued by inconsistent latency. She rearchitected the backend using Go, slashing response times by 40% and reducing daily error logs by 65%. Her ability to distill complex problems into actionable steps made the team feel confident tackling technical debt head-on.  

As our Senior Backend Engineer, Tatiana balances deep technical rigor with a collaborative mindset. She writes Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks, freeing her team to focus on innovation. Her REST API designs are clean, well-documented, and consistently meet the needs of cross-functional teams. When PostgreSQL queries slowed down during peak hours, she optimized indexing and query patterns, boosting throughput by 30% without external tools.  

Beyond code, Tatiana’s work ethic is a benchmark. She mentors junior engineers, fostering a culture of curiosity and accountability. During a recent sprint, she stayed late to debug a critical bug, ensuring a major client’s deployment met deadlines. Her adaptability shone when we pivoted to a new feature set—she restructured legacy code to support scalability, avoiding a costly rewrite.  

Tatiana’s technical acumen, leadership, and unwavering dedication make her an invaluable asset. She doesn’t just solve problems—she elevates the entire team’s capacity to innovate. I wholeheartedly recommend her without reservation.
